field_definitions.root_endpoint_review: actual immutable root review {path,sha256}; schema below
field_definitions.complete_generation_transaction_inventor: ordered actual [{generation_index,transaction:{path,sha256}}] from generation0 through frozen run tip, including cancel generations
field_definitions.normalization_source: actual G0 categorical RF_RAW checkpoint {path,sha256}; read policy.normalization only, no new fit
field_definitions.roles: exact ordered three objects for PARENT, FIRST_COMPLETED, LAST_COMPLETED; each {role,generation_index,checkpoints:[4 objects in arm_ids order]}
field_definitions.role_checkpoint_object: {arm_id,path,sha256,policy_behavior_sha256}; must equal actual generation TRANSACTION checkpoint reference; policy body hash independently checked

endpoint_selection.FIRST_COMPLETED: minimum generation index whose actual TRANSACTION.status is READY_ALL_FOUR_UPDATED
endpoint_selection.LAST_COMPLETED: maximum generation index whose actual TRANSACTION.status is READY_ALL_FOUR_UPDATED
endpoint_selection.cancel_generation: included in complete inventory but never substituted for a completed update
endpoint_selection.one_completed_batch: FIRST_COMPLETED and LAST_COMPLETED may refer to identical actual immutable checkpoints; still perform and bill all12 logical mean calls
endpoint_selection.no_completed_update: reject deployment inventory; never fabricate future models or relabel parent as completed

root_review_required_fields.original_evidence_files_sha256: nonempty actual closed computation/publication/physics review file map
root_review_required_fields.generation_inventory_object_sha256: canonical SHA of the complete_generation_transaction_inventory list
root_review_required_fields.latest_published_generation_index: actual closed frozen run tip, including any later cancelled generation

deployment_authorization_fields.deployment_deadline_unix: new read-only deployment deadline at or before original global stop; does not extend training clock
deployment_authorization_fields.source_files_sha256: extension, frozen beta_policy/axis, actual A3 proof adapter+manifest+bundle+causal/scoped APIs and complete job/source closure; every member must be actual config.frozen_artifacts
